books.title: The Mindfulness Code: Keys for Overcoming Stress, Anxiety, Fear, and Unhappiness
books.author: Donald Altman
books.description: Altman sets out mindfulness as four keys, of body, mind, spirit and relationship, joining older contemplative teaching with findings from brain research. Each key comes with everyday practices and stories for meeting a hurried life with more ease and contentment.

books.title: Clearing Emotional Clutter: Mindfulness Practices for Letting Go of What's Blocking Your Fulfillment and Transformation
books.author: Donald Altman
books.description: A four-part guide to letting go of the emotional baggage that builds up over a lifetime, from personal hurts to family and ancestral patterns. Altman pairs mindfulness exercises with a daily habit of decluttering and ends on purpose and wholeness.

books.title: Art of the Inner Meal: The Power of Mindful Practices to Heal Our Food Cravings
books.author: Donald Altman
books.description: A former Buddhist monk looks at how Hindu, Buddhist, Jewish, Christian and Muslim traditions regard food, fasting and the shared meal. The book suggests ways to make eating a daily practice of awareness, gratitude and connection.

books.title: Simply Mindful Meal by Meal: 101 Mindful Ways to Create a Healthy Relationship with Food
books.author: Donald Altman
books.description: Short daily meditations and reflections on hunger, eating and food rituals, organised around a four-step food journey. Quotations come from Zen stories, the Rule of St Benedict, Hindu and Buddhist scripture and other wisdom traditions.
